your_games.title: Valor Mortis is out today
your_games.body: The Ghostrunner team's Napoleonic first-person soulslike launches today on PS5, Xbox Series, Steam and Day One Game Pass. You rise as a fallen Grande Armée soldier with supernatural powers; unlock is 17:00 UTC (19:00 SAST). New Game+ is planned for later this year.

your_games.title: Pokémon UNITE: Flareon & Jolteon
your_games.body: Flareon (All-Rounder) and Jolteon (Speedster) join Unite Battles today from 4PM JST. The Eevee Festival runs through 1 Dec with a special Appeal-o-rama quick battle — Flareon's license is free during the event.

your_games.title: Enshrouded 1.0 in two days
your_games.body: Keen Games leaves early access Thursday 15 Oct on PC and PS5 (Xbox slips to spring 2027). Survival crafting with Sparkworks creator tools — the closest big release this week to a Valheim-style loop.

your_games.title: Resident Evil on Switch 2 this Friday
your_games.body: RE2 Deluxe, RE3 and RE4 Gold Edition (with Separate Ways) go digital on Switch 2 on 16 Oct. Boxed copies follow 29 Jan 2027 — handy if you want RE4 portable after the PS5 run.

your_games.title: It Takes Two hits Switch 2 Thursday
your_games.body: Hazelight's co-op adventure lands 15 Oct with a free upgrade for Switch owners, Friend's Pass, GameShare, and same-day cross-play with PC, Xbox and PlayStation. Docked targets 1080p60.

industry.title: Battlefield 6 joins Game Pass today
industry.body: EA's all-out warfare shooter hits Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass today (cloud, Series X|S and PC). Ultimate includes EA Play perks like the Deployment Pack and Season 5 rewards — a big freebie if you have the sub.

industry.title: Deep Dish Dungeon day-one Game Pass
industry.body: Also out today: a survival exploration dungeon crawler with metroidvania and crafting, solo or online co-op. Day one on Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass.

industry.title: Japan Midnight Black PS5 Digital
industry.body: SIE announced a Japan-only Midnight Black PS5 Digital Edition for 19 Nov (¥55,000) — same day as GTA 6 — plus a matching disc drive. Japanese language and Japan-region account required; pre-orders open 20 Oct in Japan.
